+5V.source: the input range of the charger block U1: charger(vin=(4.75, 5.25), cell=Cell(volts=(2.5, 4.3)))

+BATT.source: the cell of the charger block U1: charger(vin=(4.75, 5.25), cell=Cell(volts=(2.5, 4.3))); the fixture's cell, made up for tests/boards: 2.5 V to 4.3 V, 0.5 A in charge, 3 A in discharge

-BATT.source: the cell's negative, 2 transistors from GND: under 115 mV, or U2 opens them [BQ297xx datasheet, SLUSBU9I, section 6.6, VOCD, TA = -40 C to 85 C, -15 mV to 15 mV, page 6]

U2_FETS.source: between the 2 transistors, GND and -BATT: under 115 mV, or U2 opens them [BQ297xx datasheet, SLUSBU9I, section 6.6, VOCD, TA = -40 C to 85 C, -15 mV to 15 mV, page 6]

CHG.source: the host's pull-up on J1 pin 3, to the input at the most

J3.1.source: the system's load on J3: 1 A at the most, this fixture's own
